author: Marlon Chaviano
name: blog-astro
title: Blog with Astro
description: Astro's official blog: posts in Markdown and MDX with typed content collections, RSS, sitemap and SEO, ready to publish.
setupTasks: Astro: change `site` in `astro.config.mjs` and the data in `src/consts.ts` (the blog's title and description).
instructions:
## How to work here

- Each post is a `.md`/`.mdx` file in `src/content/blog/`; its fields (title, date, image) are validated by the schema in `src/content.config.ts`.
- A post's images live next to it and are used with `<Image />` from `astro:assets`.
- Before finishing: `npm run build`.
